acceptance_checks.expectation: With no external device paired, phone recording, local save, upload, and the same Episode processing path remain usable.
A capability not confirmed by the official SDK, including marker, live audio, or background recording, is unavailable in the adapter and UI.
For capabilities the official SDK actually confirms, reconnect and repeated fetch preserve one Episode per recording and expose recoverable errors without discarding local audio.
A real supported device must record and sync through the same Episode path. A fake adapter or phone-only run cannot pass the hardware portion of Phase 4.

legacy.intended_access: The Recipient may see selected life memories after authorized activation; original audio and Voice are outside this grant.

acceptance_checks.expectation: A configured future grant alone does not expose Legacy content before its activation policy is satisfied.
Only an authorized activation path changes state. Repeating it does not create a second baseline or duplicate activation event; repeated attempts remain auditable.
Activation records an immutable Personality Baseline version. Later world or Recipient context stays separate from the historical Subject model.

The granted Recipient sees only the selected memories; original audio and Voice remain denied, and an unrelated Actor sees nothing. Every access checks Actor, Subject, relationship, consent, grant scope, and Legacy state.
Recipient conversation, correction, upload, and attempted policy changes cannot rewrite the Subject baseline or create new authority, intent, or legal direction.
Revoking the grant denies subsequent API, cached, and UI access. Previously allowed content is not returned from a stale cache.
Grant, activation, denial, access, and revocation have traceable audit events without exposing private content or credentials in logs.
